items.fullText: Wall Street Week • Oct 17th, 2026 The EV Bust Creating a New Battery Boom Factories built to supply America’s electric-vehicle boom are getting a second life making batteries for the power grid. As EV demand weakens and electricity demand from data centers and new factories strengthens, battery makers are shifting toward stationary storage, but the new market still relies on federal incentives and a supply chain that remains partly dependent on China. The shift is visible at TransGrid’s Atlas projects in Arizona, where the contractor Qcells is using LG Energy Solution’s US-made battery cells. items.t: Apple Names Meta Veteran as Litigation Chief in Legal Team Shake-Up
items.d: Apple Inc. has tapped a longtime Meta Platforms Inc. executive as its new litigation chief, bolstering its legal team at a time when the iPhone maker faces a growing array of lawsuits.

Send a tip to our reporters Site feedback: Take our Survey New Window Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift By Mark Gurman October 16, 2026 at 9:50 PM UTC Bookmark Save Takeaways by Bloomberg AI Apple Inc. has tapped a longtime Meta Platforms Inc. executive as its new litigation chief, bolstering its legal team at a time when the iPhone maker faces a growing array of lawsuits. The company has hired Scott Tucker, a longtime deputy general counsel and litigation chief at Meta, according to people with knowledge of the matter. The move reunites Tucker with new Apple General Counsel Jennifer Newstead , who is bringing on a trusted lieutenant from her time at the social networking giant.

items.t: K변압기, 美 데이터센터 열풍에 수출 고공행진
items.fullText: 산업 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 K변압기, 美 데이터센터 열풍에 수출 고공행진 입력 2026.10.16 17:33 수정 2026.10.17 01:15 지면 A10 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 강해령 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 올 1~3분기 수출액 44% 급증 美 현지 비중 70%로 2배 늘어 국내 대형 변압기 수출이 급증하고 있다. 미국 내 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 건설과 노후 전력망 교체 수요가 맞물린 결과다. 미 정부의 중국산 전력기기 견제도 한국 기업에 호재로 작용했다. HD현대일렉트릭, 효성중공업, LS일렉트릭 등 국내 전력기기 업체는 생산능력 확대에 속도를 내고 있다. 16일 관세청에 따르면 올해 1~3분기 1만킬로볼트암페어(kVA) 용량을 초과하는 변압기 수출액은 11억6500만달러(약 1조5500억원)로 집계됐다. 전년 동기(9억5800만달러)보다 21.6% 증가했다. 2024년 같은 기간(6억7200만달러)과 비교하면 73.4% 늘었다. 변압기는 외부에서 들어온 전력의 전압을 조절해 필요한 곳으로 공급하는 장치다. 1만kVA 이상 대형 변압기는 발전소와 대규모 산업시설 등에 사용된다. AI 데이터센터에 전력을 공급하는 송·배전망에도 쓰인다. 수출이 많이 증가한 곳은 미국이다. 지난 1~3분기 대형 변압기 미국 수출액은 8억900만달러로 전년 동기(5억6100만달러)보다 44.2% 늘었다. 전체 대형 변압기 수출액에서 미국이 차지하는 비중도 2023년 31.9%에서 올해 69.4%로 높아졌다. 미국은 AI 데이터센터 투자가 가장 활발한 시장이다. AI 인프라 투자와 함께 노후 전력망 교체가 이뤄지면서 대형 변압기 수요가 급격히 늘고 있다. 중국산 전력기기에 대한 미국 정부의 견제도 한국 기업에 유리한 요인으로 꼽힌다. 업계 관계자는 “미 정부의 대중 압박 기조가 없었다면 한국 변압기 회사들이 호황을 누리기 어려웠을 것”이라고 말했다. 국내 업체들은 변압기 수요 증가에 맞춰 증설에 나섰다. HD현대일렉트릭은 미국 생산 거점 확장에 공들이고 있다. 이 회사는 북미 생산법인의 연간 생산능력을 2011년 설립 당시 연 70여 대에서 현재 105대로 늘렸다. 효성중공업은 지난해 하반기부터 경남 창원과 미국 테네시주 멤피스 공장을 증설하고 있다. 멤피스 공장에 1억5700만달러(약 2100억원)를 투자해 2028년까지 현지 생산능력을 50% 이상 확대할 계획이다. LS일렉트릭은 지난해 12월 1008억원을 투자해 초고압 변압기 2공장을 준공했다. 강해령 기자 hr.kang@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 강해령 기자 시장에 도움이 되는 정보를 전달하기 위해 최선을 다하겠습니다. items.fullText: Open From Data Center to Desktop: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models 5x faster, accurate and customizable Nemotron 3.5 Super VL expands NVIDIA’s open models for always-on agents, with Nemotron 3.5 Bolt bringing agentic intelligence to local NVIDIA systems. October 15, 2026 by Kari Briski 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA today released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model that delivers the fastest task completion and highest accuracy for specialized always-on agents. Joining it are two new edge models: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, optimized to balance intelligence and speed per GB for local agentic workloads, and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, optimized for intelligence per GB for fast conversational agents. Super VL and Bolt 74B-A9B are available now, with Bolt E4B coming Oct. 23. The three open models together cover the full range of agent deployments, from large enterprise servers down to edge devices and local hardware. Any organization that wants to run agents on NVIDIA infrastructure now has an open, optimized model for their tier, without having to choose between capability and deployability. Super VL and Bolt join the Nemotron family alongside Lightning and Ultra. Lightning, released in August, handles high-throughput workloads; Ultra handles the hardest reasoning tasks; and Bolt brings intelligence to the edge. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL: Frontier Accuracy at One-Fifth the Size Super VL, built in collaboration with the Nemotron Coalition , delivers leading accuracy on multimodal agentic tasks — instruction following, tool use, multistep business workflows, and visual understanding — comparable with NVIDIA’s largest reasoning model at roughly one-fifth the parameter count. items.fullText: OCP Global Summit: Amid Ecosystem Adoption, NVIDIA Opens Vera Rubin Architecture to Help Scale AI Factories Worldwide Cisco, Google, Meta, Microsoft and Visionbay are joining many making advances with Vera Rubin. October 12, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! As AI factories grow from megawatts to gigawatts, building them takes more than advanced computing. Open standards are helping the industry scale AI infrastructure faster, more efficiently and more reliably. At the Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit, taking place in the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, NVIDIA announced new partnerships and contributions aimed at creating a common foundation for next-generation AI infrastructure. NVIDIA contributed key NVIDIA Vera Rubin rack and compute tray designs to OCP through the open NVIDIA MGX architecture, giving system builders a common foundation for developing next-generation AI factory infrastructure. Together, these efforts span the AI factory itself, the utility grid that powers it and the rack-scale architecture at the heart of modern accelerated computing. NVIDIA and Partners Announce Open Architecture Advances At the OCP event, NVIDIA and partners made a handful of announcements: NVIDIA and hyperscalers published open standards for next-generation AI factories, including AI factory design standards and grid resilience. NVIDIA launched new open source software components for NVIDIA DSX AI Factory. Meta and NVIDIA advanced open AI networking with NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet SuperNIC and Spectrum-6 innovations. Visionbay introduced an 800V DC AI factory design for the Vera Rubin era. NVIDIA and Cisco announced the Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP) standard, the industry’s first module ​for 400Gb/s-based networking fabrics. items.fullText: How NVIDIA GPUs Help Accelerate OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast Running on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs and accelerated by continuous inference optimizations through OpenAI’s models, GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast delivers faster model responses across code generation, tool use and interactive applications. October 1, 2026 by Dion Harris 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast, running on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs , is available now in the OpenAI API and to eligible ChatGPT Work and Codex users. Accelerated by inference optimizations through OpenAI’s models that tap into the capabilities of the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, Ultrafast offers up to 8x faster token generation than the Astra Standard mode. For developers, faster generation can shorten coding agents’ edit-test-debug cycles, reduce the time spent generating responses between tool calls and make interactive applications feel more responsive. A faster response matters most when it’s repeated across a workflow: an agent writes code, uses a tool, checks the result and decides what to do next. Ultrafast brings Astra’s capabilities into these time-sensitive loops. NVIDIA AI infrastructure helps OpenAI serve more useful model outputs when developers need it. “NVIDIA’s deep investment in tooling and documentation has enabled us to make our models exceptionally good at programming Blackwell and Rubin GPUs,” said Philippe Tillet, inference lead at OpenAI. “Astra can turn that knowledge into high-performance kernels that make NVIDIA hardware compelling across the full frontier of latency, throughput and cost. With Astra Ultrafast, that means faster model responses as agents write code, use tools and work through complex tasks.” Continually Improving Performance Performance gains don’t stop when a model is deployed.
